name: Pleasanteas | 30mg Tea | Peach
description:
30mg Infused Tea

Arguably the tastiest orchard fruit: ripe, juicy peaches are a tasty treat with rich Michigan history. Our favorite seasonal fruit, available 24/7, 365. Talk about a drink the really has it all.

--

Pleasanteas are best served ice cold & enjoyed with your friends. Cheers!
